summary: Both reviewers approved the diff as accurate and well-tagged; only two independent nits remain, no blockers.

Keep the @return tag on trySplit (the description doesn't begin with "Returns", so it can't be dropped under house rule) but rework it to add something the description doesn't already say, instead of restating it almost verbatim.
